text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Air Messiah—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking where Air Messiah is pointing,
there was a claw crane machine filled with plushies styled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...They resemble them.
The stuffed animals my mother gave me when I was little.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I used to sleep with them a lot.
They even helped me try to overcome my shyness.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I don't have it on hand right now, but... it brings back memories.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...I hear that something like this
requires seasoned skill."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: So, it's all right. I'm not a child anymore like I used to be.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Contrary to her words, her
lonely gaze was fixed on
the plushie in the claw crane machine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
